name: Szabolcs Veres-Lakos
headline: Mechanical engineer moving into embedded systems, IT and LLM tooling.
about: I design railway weed-control equipment at G & G Kft. Along the way I took over the company's Autodesk Vault rollout and started automating CAD work with iLogic and Python. That side of the job turned out to be the part I enjoy most.
Now I spend my own time on hardware and software: porting radio firmware to new boards, building the app that talks to them, and learning how language models can drive real engineering tools.

timeline.title: Mechanical Engineer, G & G Kft.
timeline.text: Product development for railway weed control. Vault PDM rollout and admin, iLogic automation, on-site engineering support.

timeline.title: Assembly Technician, G & G Kft.
timeline.text: Built the machines I now design.

contact: Open to roles in embedded systems, engineering IT and PLM. Code and progress on GitHub.
